relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.evidence: He completed his initial studies from the Mrityunjaya School and Ananda Mohan College in Mymensingh.

relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.evidence: In 1924, he passed his B.A. examination in History from Murari Chand College, Sylhet.

relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.evidence: In 1926, he stood first in the M.A. examination in Ancient Indian History and Culture from the University of Calcutta.

relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.evidence: In 1935, he passed his diploma in Librarianship from the London University College.

relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.role: Chief Librarian in the Central Library
relations.evidence: He was appointed the Chief Librarian in the Central Library of Calcutta University in 1936.

relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.evidence: In 1946, he was appointed Bageswari Professor of Fine Arts in Calcutta University and retired from the post in 1965.

relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.evidence: He was the General Secretary of the Asiatic Society, Calcutta from 1949 to 1950.

relations.subject: Niharranjan Ray
relations.object: Indian Institute of Advanced Study, Shimla
relations.evidence: In 1965, he became the First Director of the Indian Institute of Advanced Study, Shimla and remained in office till 1970.

relations.subject: Pranabranjan Ray
relations.evidence: His son, Pranabranjan Ray, is a historian.
